items.question: Shin Avenqo yana maye gurbin kayan aikina na yanzu?
items.answer: Avenqo yana haɗawa da yanayin ku kuma yana tattara shawarwari, shawarwarin, da atomatik a cikin gogewa ɗaya.

items.question: Zan iya farawa da module ɗaya kawai?
items.answer: Eh. Fara da babban fifikon ku, sannan ƙara ikon a saurin kasuwancin ku.

items.question: Shin bayanaina an keɓe su?
items.answer: Eh. Kowane kamfani yana da nasa wurin aiki, nasa shiga, da bayanan da aka raba sosai.

items.question: Shin Avenqo ya dace da ƙananan da matsakaitan kamfanoni?
items.answer: Eh. Tsare-tsaren mu suna goyan bayan duka ƙungiya mai girma da kungiya mai reshe da yawa.

items.question: Nawa lokaci ake bukata don farawa?
items.answer: Ana ƙirƙiri wurin aikinku nan take. Lokacin haɗi ya dogara da kayan aikin da aka zaɓa.
